<thought>Based on the strong M+2 peak (~33% of the base peak) the spectrum shows the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). The sizable M+1 peak (~10%) indicates the presence of multiple carbon atoms (13C natural abundance ~1.1% per carbon). No other element shows a distinctive pattern at these intensities. Therefore the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
